title: `topics/dualist-perception` states Block's contested overflow inference as fact (L90 "The information was in the experience but exceeded what access-consciousness could retrieve") and closes L94 unconditionally ("The richness of perceptual experience reflects the richness of consciousness itself"), against `voids/plenitude-void`'s thesis that the rich/sparse question cannot be settled from within; its Sperling whole-report figure ("3-4") disagrees with `concepts/phenomenal-overflow` ("4-5")
